There’s a lot of viral fabricated screenshots of me going around recently. 

Some are annoying jokes for engagement, like text-edited posts from me citing bible verses.

But some like “Innolight secures Nvidia NPO orders” or off platform promotional content are maliciously https://t.co/VxV5T4ItR5
Happy to see TRON in the BEST pick — literally and figuratively.
